target_lane: W1 recipe/consumer data; no production edits or automatic adoption
selection_policy: Report all measured arms. For this exact DEV source-commitment task, j_directed is the minimum-billed-cost member of the 43/48 Jev accuracy tie. g_rules_t03 is the local GPT-family accuracy maximum. These are provisional task-specific recipe candidates, not statistical, semantic-generalization or Stage5 winners.
scope_limits: 12 authored DEV cases reused across arms;48 judgments per scored arm are dependent controls, not48 independent model trials.
All leading Jev arms still wrongly refute5/24 unknown cases; GPT local best wrongly refutes10/24 unknown cases.
No source grounding/world-truth/general graph-completion/pattern/reply quality is inferred from these source-commitment labels.
Observed dated model/provider identities remain distinct from requested aliases and original consumed bodies.
Host latency cohorts include3 original completed,3 original uncertain and426 deferred-billing starts; no provider-only latency or split wall-time claim.
No Stage5 corpus/labels were read, no Stage5 eligibility evaluated and no winner selected.
